newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tongkah to buy stake in finance company.
newsitem.headline: Tongkah to buy stake in finance company.

text.p: Malaysia's United Merchant Group Bhd (UMG) said on Monday that its 70.1 percent-owned subsidiary, Perdana Merchant Bankers Bhd has agreed to sell its entire stake in a finance company to Tongkah Holdings Bhd.
UMG said in a statement that Perdana Merchant Bankers plans to sell its 88 percent interest in Perdana Finance Bhd for 84.48 million ringgit in cash.
The proposed disposal is expected to realise an extraordinary gain of about 22 million ringgit to the UMG group, it said.

UMG said the central bank, Bank Negara Malaysia, has approved the proposed sale, which, however, is still subject to approval of the Securities Commission and shareholders of Tongkah and Perdana Merchant Bankers. -- Kuala Lumpur newsroom (603-230 8911)
